quarterly_data.quarter: Fluence Energy press release: Fluence Secures Long-Term Battery Supply Through Multiyear (09-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fluence announced a multiyear master supply agreement with EVE Power Co., Ltd. (EVE Power), described in the release as an established global lithium battery manufacturer; under the agreement EVE Power will supply batteries for Fluence energy storage systems. The company says the agreement provides visibility into volume and pricing to support its global customer commitments. Roman Loosen, SVP and Chief Supply Chain Officer, called EVE Power 'an important strategic partner' with 'significant opportunity to build on this relationship globally' and said the partnership strengthens access to advanced battery technology and supports meeting customer commitments 'with greater agility and cost certainty'. The agreement supports Fluence's global supply strategy; separately, Fluence continues to tailor its U.S. supply-chain approach (including its domestic content offering) and to explore localization approaches for other markets. No volumes, dollar value, term length or start date stated.
